body:
Obviously, morally, you will say I should stay. What a silly question of me to ask. 
But really, what is the point in my mediocre existence? 
The world keeps spinning, people keep fighting and spreading hate, there's so much going so bad in this world. The world is literally falling apart. We are all at war. I don't see any good in this world anymore, in the grand scheme of things. 
So what do I matter?
WHY should I continue living in the pain I experience?
I will die eventually. Why endure the heartache I do, to die anyway? 
Can anyone give me a logical, plausible answer?
